top_signals.title: Odd Lots: What It’s Like to Collaborate With Big Brand Names
top_signals.summary:
In the age of brand collaborations, how do companies work together to benefit from each other's influence?

On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, Fishwife CEO Becca Millstein joins Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal to talk about the company's partnership with brands like Whole Foods and Fly By Jing. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Water utilities group partners with DEF CON offshoot for Water Watch Center
top_signals.summary: The National Rural Water Association and a group of cybersecurity experts have formed a program to help cash-strapped utilities face the increase in threats to their systems.
